summary: Implemented all 7 plan phases: relocated the regression-anchor's deliberate-false mutation from the real source-store file onto the already-copied sandbox file under test, eliminating the backup/trap/restore machinery and the concurrency hazard it only partially mitigated. Added a mechanical detector (gate 28, lint-deliberate-break-residue.sh) with its own four-case suite, in-suite byte-identity and anchor-bak-absence invariants, and a stated safe-pattern rule in the testing standard. Redeployed via deploy-headless.sh; every load-bearing check (the regression-anchor case, the non-vacuousness assertion, both invariants, the new detector/suite, gate 28) passes. Per the dispatch's Batch Gate Deferral directive, the complete independent gate/test pool run was deferred to the batch stage; three unrelated, pre-existing verify-deploy.sh gate failures (eager-load budget drift, a shellcheck finding, a dead-command-recommendation finding) were confirmed untouched by this dispatch via git history.
